# Nuli

> Nuli makes small, friendly mobile apps. Its main app is Mandarin Hero.

## Mandarin Hero

Mandarin Hero is an iPhone app (Android coming) for learning colloquial, everyday spoken Mandarin Chinese: the language people actually speak, not textbook Chinese. It's made for people serious about learning Chinese who want to hold real conversations, from complete beginners up. It doesn't promise fluency in weeks: no nonsense, no fluff, it makes every hour of study count by going straight to what builds real proficiency.

- 32 lessons, each a real-life situation (ordering food, a taxi, the airport, the doctor, chatting on WeChat, KTV): first its key words, then its handy phrases, then the conversation as people really have it, then a role-play where you say your part out loud.
- Spaced repetition: every word and phrase comes back right before you'd forget it.
- Natural example sentences with the particles natives use (啊, 呢, 吧, 嘛), audio on every line, tone practice from day one, and a memory story for every character.
- All HSK 1–6 vocabulary (about 5,000 words) for extra practice.
- The whole app is in English or Dutch.
- Free to start, no ads. Hero Pro unlocks all lessons and HSK 3–6.

- [Mandarin Hero](https://nuli.nl/apps/mandarinhero/): what it is, screenshots and pricing
- [Mandarin Hero blog](https://nuli.nl/apps/mandarinhero/blog/): guides to everyday spoken Mandarin
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/mandarin-hero/id6802076609)
- [Support](https://nuli.nl/apps/mandarinhero/support/)

## Coach Hero (coming soon)

Coach Hero is an upcoming iPhone and Android app by Nuli: a personal training coach for Garmin watch owners that combines the expertise of a professional athlete's support team (head coach, strength, endurance, mobility, recovery, nutrition, injury prevention and data analysis) in one coach. Every new training block is reviewed from each of these perspectives before it reaches the watch. It is not made or endorsed by Garmin, and it is not medical advice.

- Every morning it compares last night's sleep, HRV, resting heart rate and Body Battery to the user's own 60-day baseline, factor by factor, and says GO, MODIFY or REST with the specific change to today's session.
- It plans training in blocks toward measurable goals (strength 1RM, race times, VO2max, muscle, calisthenics skills, body composition) and puts every workout on the Garmin watch: strength with sets, reps, weights and rest; runs, rides and walks with heart-rate zone or pace targets.
- A weekly check-in re-plans the next week from what was actually done, and works around injuries, schedule and equipment.

- [Coach Hero](https://nuli.nl/apps/coachhero/): what it does and its waitlist
